result.description:
Our client, OSMO Creations, transforms ideas into impactful outcomes through design, storytelling, and innovation. As a multidisciplinary creative studio based in Australia, they operate at the crossroads of strategy, design, and technology. From their headquarters in Para Hills West, South Australia, they bring together Designers, Producers, Filmmakers, and digital specialists to deliver outstanding, integrated solutions.

They are now looking for a Digital Production Manager to join their creative team. In this role, you will act as the vital link between creative vision and seamless delivery, managing the end-to-end production of digital content assets, including video, motion graphics, and interactive experiences, while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with brand standards.

The annual salary for the Digital Production Manager is $80,000 to $81,000 plus superannuation.

Duties include:

•	Lead project planning: scope, timeline, resource allocation, budget.

•	Liaise with creative teams (Designers, Editors, Animators, Developers) to ensure deliverables meet the creative brief.

•	Manage production workflows: pre-production, shoot/asset capture, post-production, delivery.

•	Maintain high-quality standards and brand consistency across all outputs.

•	Anticipate and resolve production risks and bottlenecks.

•	Track project metrics and provide status updates to stakeholders.

•	Continuously optimise production processes for efficiency and scalability.

•	Collaborate closely with clients and account teams to interpret creative briefs and translate them into actionable production plans.

•	Oversee vendor relationships, including freelance creatives, post-production partners, and technical suppliers, ensuring deliverables meet OSMO’s standards.

•	Implement and maintain digital asset management systems and file-naming conventions to streamline workflow and ensure version control.

•	Drive innovation in production processes by exploring new tools, software, and emerging technologies that enhance creativity and efficiency.

•	Support business development by providing production insights, timelines, and cost estimates during pitches and proposal stages.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least two (2) years of relevant experience.

•	Should hold at least an AQF Bachelor or higher qualification, or equivalent qualifications and have at least 2 years of recent and relevant work experience; or 5 years of relevant work experience may substitute for a qualification.

•	Should have at least one (1) year of relevant work experience where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia; or have at least two (2) years of relevant work experience.
result.title: Digital Production Manager

About the Company

Aggreko Australia Pty Ltd (formerly Aggreko Generator Rentals Pty Ltd) is a provider of flexible power generation solutions in Australia and the Pacific. It maintains global leadership in the temporary power generation marketplace by offering innovative rental solutions. Aggreko is a major player in the global power market. Aggreko has an established record of working with businesses to improve their outputs, manage power demands and plan for emergencies. Our specialised technology is critical to the operations of several global businesses, and we have continued to rapidly grow across the mining, construction and emergency service sector.

Position Description

We are seeking a dedicated Project Support Technician- Mechanical to join our team on a full-time basis. In this role you will be responsible for the following:

Provide product support to all ongoing Projects and new installs by way of operator relief, preventative maintenance, site repairs and commissioning.
Assist in new Installations, including commissioning, operating and training other staff of best practices.
Training of Power Station Operators in Aggreko maintenance and quality standards.
Timely and effectively carry out; internal maintenance and repairs, customer site installations / removals.
Carry out effective troubleshooting to minimise downtime and unnecessary repair costs
Carry out all electrical and mechanical repairs and checking of company assets in accordance with the company's policy.
Maintenance & troubleshooting of all hire fleet assets to ensure we receive the best possible returns on expenditure.

About You

To be successful in obtaining this role, you will have :
Proven experience in a similar role
Relevant trade qualification
Exceptional communication skills.
Strong customer focus.
Ability to work under pressure and make deadlines.
Planning, problem solving and coordination skills.
Ability to work unsupervised at times.
Job Type: Full-time

Full-time Office Manager position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Sydney NSW 2036. 

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Office Manager
•	Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
AUSF Group Pty Ltd is an Australian private company headquartered in Sydney, New South Wales. We specialise in providing comprehensive maintenance and service solutions across multiple sectors. The company's core service offerings include construction and property services — encompassing tiling, painting, and general construction works — as well as logistics services, including forklift operations and container unloading. AUSF Group is committed to delivering reliable, high-quality, and tailored solutions to its clients.

About the role
The Office Manager ensures the efficient and smooth daily operation of the AUSF Group Pty Ltd office. This role provides comprehensive administrative support across the business. The Office Manager acts as the central point of contact for facilities, human resources support, financial administration, and general team assistance. The successful candidate will drive a positive workplace culture and maintain high standards of operational compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Oversee reception duties, greet visitors, and manage incoming calls.  Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence, couriers, and packages.
•	Monitor and order office supplies, kitchen consumables, and stationery.
•	Identify and implement improvements to administrative systems and workflows.
•	Draft and distribute internal office communications and updates.
•	Liaise with building management, cleaners, IT support, and maintenance contractors.
•	Coordinate the servicing and repair of office equipment and appliances.
•	Coordinate inductions for new employees.
•	Maintain accurate and confidential employee files and HR databases. Assist with tracking employee leave and attendance records.
•	Organize team-building activities, staff milestones, and corporate events.
•	Act as the primary WHS representative for the office.  Identify, report, and mitigate workplace hazards.
•	Ensure staff compliance with general office policies and procedures.
•	Provide general administrative assistance to the executive team as required.

Essential Skills

•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
•	Exceptional time management and the ability to prioritize competing tasks.
•	A proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing effective solutions.
•	High level of integrity and the ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
•	Ability to remain calm and effective in a fast-paced, changing environment.
•	Strong ability to build positive relationships with staff, management, and external stakeholders.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Diploma level or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

result.description:
Role Purpose

The ICT Business Development Manager will identify, develop and manage commercial opportunities for ICT and digital business solutions. The role is responsible for understanding client technology requirements, promoting ICT services, preparing solution proposals, managing client relationships, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to support successful delivery of digital and technology-enabled business solutions.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Identify and develop new business opportunities for ICT, digital transformation, software, web, automation, IT support and business process technology services.
Research target markets, industry trends, competitor activity and client requirements to support ICT business growth strategies.
Engage with prospective and existing clients to understand ICT needs, operational challenges and opportunities for technology-enabled improvement.
Prepare ICT solution proposals, presentations, business cases, quotes and service scope documents in consultation with technical and management teams.
Promote the organisation's ICT and digital services to clients, partners and stakeholders through professional consultation and relationship management.
Manage the business development pipeline, including lead generation, qualification, follow-up, negotiation support and conversion reporting.
Coordinate with technical teams, consultants, vendors and service partners to ensure proposed ICT solutions are commercially viable and deliverable.
Support contract discussions, client onboarding, implementation planning and post-sale client relationship management for ICT service engagements.
Maintain CRM records, sales forecasts, client communication records and management reports relating to ICT business development activities.
Develop strategic partnerships and referral channels for ICT services, digital solutions, remote staffing, outsourcing and business process support.
Monitor project and client feedback to identify service improvements, renewal opportunities and additional ICT solution requirements.
Ensure business development activities comply with company policies, ethical standards and applicable employment, privacy and commercial obligations.
Required Experience

Minimum five (5) years of professional experience in business development, sales, client relationship management, management consulting, project coordination or a closely related commercial role.
At least two (2) years of the total experience must be closely related to ICT business development, ICT sales, digital solutions, technology services, software/web solutions, IT outsourcing, business process technology or digital transformation services.
Demonstrated experience identifying client ICT needs, preparing commercial proposals and supporting the sale or delivery of ICT/digital services.
Experience working with technical teams, vendors, consultants or project delivery teams to translate client requirements into practical ICT service solutions.
Experience using CRM systems, market research, sales reporting, stakeholder management and business communication tools.
Required Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor degree or higher in Business, Management, Marketing, Information Technology, Digital Business, Project Management or a closely related field. An MBA or postgraduate business qualification is highly regarded.
Strong understanding of ICT services, digital transformation, technology-enabled business solutions and commercial proposal development.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare professional proposals, reports and client presentations.
Strong analytical, negotiation, stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and coordinate with internal and external teams in a professional environment.
Selection Criteria

Proven ability to generate and manage ICT-related business development opportunities.
Strong commercial understanding of client needs, solution scoping and ICT service delivery requirements.
Ability to build long-term client relationships and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated capacity to prepare high-quality proposals, reports and business cases for ICT/digital services.
Ability to contribute to business growth, market expansion and service improvement strategies.
Employment Conditions

This is a full-time position based in Canberra, ACT. Primary location: Canberra, ACT. The employee may be required to work from other Australian locations if required by the employer due to business or project needs. The employee will work 38 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Remuneration is AUD 150,000 gross per annum plus superannuation, subject to final employment agreement. The role is intended to support ongoing ICT business development and digital solutions growth for the business.

For the candidate
Full Time Contract
Hybrid location - Sydney
This is a permanent role so please only apply if you have full working rights in Australia.
No recruitment agencies please

POSITION DESCRIPTION
JOB TITLE: Restaurant Manager
JOB TYPE: Full Time
REPORTS TO: Venue Manager
LOCATION: Maha Restaurant, 21 Bond Street, Melbourne, 3000
ROLE:
The Restaurant Manager will be responsible for managing front of house operations in conjunction with, or, in the absence of the Venue Manager. A key part of the role will be to supervise the front of house team and provide assistance, guidance and training to junior team members as identified/required. The Restaurant Manager will ensure that the venue is always presented at the standard set by the Venue Manager. This will be in relation to cleanliness, lighting, music, temperature, staff presentation, and readiness for service. The Restaurant Manager will be able to run any or all section(s) of the dining room as required and be comfortable assisting the bar team as well as taking bookings and hosting the venue. The Restaurant Manager will work collaboratively with the front of house and back of house managers to ensure that restaurant standards are maintained at the highest possible level and guests are receiving exceptional experiences that exceed expectations. A key part of this will be to monitor lunch and dinner services and maintain the highest standards of customer care. The Restaurant Manager will play an active role in ensuring labour cost targets are achieved in compliance with regulations by evaluating and managing rostering, start and finish times and breaks of team members. The Restaurant Manager will control costs for front of house peripherals such as linen and paper goods by always ensuring efficient ordering and stock management. The Restaurant Manager will raise and, where possible, address any maintenance or safety issues in the venue as they arise to ensure a safe working environment for all staff. 

MAIN DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:
•	Play a key role in the management of all front of house operations by providing support to the Venue Manager
•	Continually look to identify areas of improvement in the venue’s customer service and the efficiency with which it is run
•	Assess staff performance daily and provide constructive feedback to team members
•	Provide guidance, mentoring, and training to junior members of staff
•	Ensure that the cleanliness of the venue is at the highest possible level and address any issues as required
•	Ensure that the ambience of the venue is set to the designated standard with respect to lighting, music, and temperature
•	Ensure that the staff are always presented to the required standard with respect to uniform, grooming, and personal hygiene
•	Ensure that the venue is ready for each service by ensuring all checklists are completed in full and on time
•	Manage the entire dining room during service including bar operations, hosting, and staff performance
•	Be able to address any customer complaints and resolve these to a satisfactory conclusion
•	Ensure that the highest standards of customer service are constantly being delivered to all guests
•	Monitor service times and make effective decisions/contributions that benefit the customer experience
•	Bring any maintenance issues to the attention of the Venue/Restaurant Manager and where possible address these issues effectively
•	Bring any safety issues to the attention of the Venue/Restaurant Manager and where possible address these issues effectively
•	Be aware of trends in the market and propose ideas/initiatives to keep the venue at the forefront of these trends
•	Assist the Venue Manager to drive sales in order to achieve KPIs in relation to spend per head 
•	Propose ideas/initiatives that will improve spend per head and help in the driving of sales
•	Be able to assist in the recommendation and service of wine in the venue when required


PERFORMANCE GOALS:

•	Continuously action and uphold the employers mission statement and core values
•	Adhere to and uphold all company policies and procedures
•	Integrate with team members and work collaboratively to achieve restaurant goals
•	Communicate effectively and appropriately with all colleagues
•	Maintain high levels of personal presentation, hygiene, and grooming
•	Observe high levels of punctuality
•	Demonstrate a consistent attitude and look to encourage and motivate colleagues
•	Assist the Venue Manager to maintain cost of goods to come in under budget by managing ordering and stock levels appropriately
•	Assist the Venue Manager to maintain wage costs by controlling rostering and monitoring hours and breaks of staff

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Estimator to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As an Estimator, you will be responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates, tenders, and quotations for engineering, fabrication, maintenance, shutdown, and industrial projects. You will work closely with project managers, engineers, procurement teams, suppliers, subcontractors, and clients to assess project requirements, develop competitive pricing, and support successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
•	Review project drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and tender documentation.
•	Prepare detailed cost estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for projects.
•	Analyse labour, materials, equipment, subcontractor, and project-related costs.
•	Conduct quantity take-offs and prepare cost breakdowns based on project requirements.
•	Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
•	Liaise with project managers, engineers, clients, and suppliers to clarify project requirements.
•	Assist with tender preparation, pricing strategies, and commercial submissions.
•	Monitor market conditions, material costs, and industry trends affecting project pricing.
•	Identify potential project risks, cost variations, and opportunities for improvement.
•	Maintain accurate estimating records, databases, and historical cost information.
•	Assist project teams with budget preparation, cost tracking, and variation assessments.
•	Ensure all estimating activities comply with company procedures, quality standards, and client requirements.
•	Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as an Estimator or in a similar estimating role.
•	Experience within mining, engineering, fabrication, construction, or industrial sectors is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of project costing, estimating principles, and tender processes.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and scopes of work.
•	Strong analytical and numerical skills with high attention to detail.
•	Ability to prepare accurate cost estimates within required timeframes.
•	Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and estimating/project management software.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a project team.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $90,000 – $120,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
